user.title: Municipality
user.description: Start typing a municipality name or select one from the list.

address.title: Select address
address.description: Open the address field and enter at least the first three characters. Filtered results appear immediately below; leave it empty to browse the full A–Z list for {municipality}.

vasa.title: VASA self-service
vasa.description: Ecoservice has now been used only to find the container inventory numbers. From this point on, all calendar, collection, weight, and billing data is retrieved exclusively from VASA. The credentials are verified by the VASA server and stored only in your Home Assistant configuration.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the public Ecoservice report.
error.invalid_municipality: Select a municipality from the suggested options.
error.vasa_auth_failed: Could not sign in to VASA. Check the credentials and whether the account requires additional verification.
